entry_timeframe_note: Use Daily for bias. Drop to 4H for entry timing — confirm TWB signal on 4H before entering.

market_context.benchmark_signal: BTC perp TWB Histogram direction is the market signal — it determines whether to scan for longs or shorts across all alts. No SMA check needed.

signal_rules.btc_twb_positive: BTC TWB Histogram > 0 → market in uptrend → scan alts for LONG setups
signal_rules.btc_twb_negative: BTC TWB Histogram < 0 → market in downtrend → scan alts for SHORT setups
signal_rules.btc_twb_crossing_zero: Histogram just crossed from negative to positive (or vice versa) → direction change — highest conviction signal, enter early
signal_rules.btc_twb_neutral_zone: Histogram near zero (within 5% of recent range) → no clear edge → reduce size or skip

market_context.funding_note: Funding rate is NOT available in TradingView — it is not in the brief payload. Check it manually on Coinbase (or the exchange) immediately before entry. Guidance: for longs, neutral or negative funding preferred; for shorts, positive funding preferred (shorts get paid). Extreme positive funding (>0.05%/hr) = crowded long → short opportunity; extreme negative funding = crowded short → long opportunity. Treat funding as a final manual confirmation step, not an automated signal.
market_context.oi_note: Open interest is NOT in the brief payload either — check it manually on Coinbase before entry if available. Guidance: rising OI with rising price = healthy uptrend (confirms long); rising OI with falling price = short pressure building (confirms short); falling OI = trend exhaustion on either side — reduce size.

bias_criteria_note: Perps allow both longs AND shorts. BTC TWB signal determines which side to trade. Apply bullish criteria for longs when BTC TWB positive; bearish criteria for shorts when BTC TWB negative. Commodity perps (SILVER, GOLD) are exempt from BTC benchmark — apply their own TWB signal independently.

bullish_long: BTC perp TWB Histogram is positive (market uptrend confirmed)
Symbol TWB Histogram positive and above its signal line
Symbol printing higher highs and higher lows on Daily
Breakout candle volume above 5-10 day average
Price approaching but NOT extended outside upper NW Envelope band
Funding rate neutral or negative (longs not crowded)
bearish_short: BTC perp TWB Histogram is negative (market downtrend confirmed)
Symbol TWB Histogram negative and below its signal line
Symbol printing lower highs and lower lows on Daily
Breakdown candle volume above 5-10 day average
Price at or below lower NW Envelope band (extended short = wait for bounce to short)
Funding rate positive (longs paying — squeeze risk adds fuel to short)
Open interest rising as price falls (shorts piling in = trend confirmation)
neutral_skip: BTC TWB Histogram near zero — no clear direction
Symbol TWB flat, histogram and signal lines converging
Price chopping inside NW Envelope bands with no trend
Funding rate near zero — no crowding either way

perp_long: Symbol TWB Histogram positive AND above signal line
Symbol consolidating near local highs — flag, pennant, or horizontal resistance
4H chart confirms same TWB bullish breakout
Funding rate neutral or negative at entry time
NW: price approaching upper band but not extended outside it
perp_short: Symbol TWB Histogram negative AND below signal line
Symbol rejecting from a key resistance level or prior breakdown zone
4H chart confirms same TWB bearish breakdown
Funding rate positive at entry (shorts get paid) — OR neutral is acceptable
NW: price bouncing up into the lower band (ideal short entry on the retrace, not the initial drop)
Do NOT short into an already-extended move — wait for a dead-cat bounce to the lower NW band

exit_criteria.long_stop: Below breakout candle low or nearest 4H swing low.
exit_criteria.long_tp1: Scale out 1/3 when price touches upper NW Envelope band.
exit_criteria.long_tp2: Scale out 1/3 at 2R. Trail remainder with 4H 9 EMA.
exit_criteria.long_tp3: Exit final 1/3 if price closes below 4H 9 EMA for two consecutive candles.
exit_criteria.short_stop: Above short entry candle high or nearest 4H swing high.
exit_criteria.short_tp1: Cover 1/3 when price touches lower NW Envelope band.
exit_criteria.short_tp2: Cover 1/3 at 2R. Trail remainder with 4H 9 EMA (from below).
exit_criteria.short_tp3: Cover final 1/3 if price closes above 4H 9 EMA for two consecutive candles.
exit_criteria.funding_exit: Exit long if funding rate spikes above 0.1%/hr. Exit short if funding rate drops below -0.05%/hr.
exit_criteria.emergency_exit: Exit ALL perp positions immediately if BTC moves 8%+ intraday in either direction.

risk_rules: Maximum 2% account risk per perp trade (long or short)
Maximum 3 open perp positions at once
Maximum 3x leverage — never higher for crypto perps
Reduce position size 50% if entering against recent funding rate direction
No perp trades when BTC TWB is in the neutral zone near zero
No trading during FOMC, CPI, or major macro events — crypto amplifies moves
Never average down on a losing perp in either direction
If BTC moves 8%+ intraday, exit ALL positions regardless of direction
For shorts: wait for dead-cat bounce to lower NW band — do NOT chase the initial drop
Commodity perps (SILVER, GOLD) use their own TWB signal — BTC benchmark does not apply to them
commodity_perps_note: SILVER and GOLD perps follow macro/USD drivers, not crypto momentum. Use the same TWB + NW framework on their own charts. Positive TWB + DXY weakening = long bias. Negative TWB + DXY strengthening = short bias. No BTC benchmark check for these.
tradeable_note: All perps in MOMENTUM-PERPS are Coinbase CDE USDC-settled contracts. No exchange check needed.
asset_notes: Coinbase perp universe is USDC-settled and regulated. Perps allow both sides — the TWB signal on BTC tells you which side the market favors today. For shorts, the ideal entry is a retrace back up into the lower NW band after an initial breakdown — not chasing the drop. Funding rate and open interest are NOT available in TradingView — check them manually on Coinbase before entry. Prefer entries during US session (9:30am-4pm ET) or Asia open (8pm-midnight ET) — avoid low-liquidity gaps in between.
